source: research_notes/QUANTGEN v2 integration map/tf_dnb_backlog.md section B
caveat: All lab numbers are in-sample computations on price returns without dividends, not runs of QUANTGEN's gate. Proposals pending owner confirmation; nothing here is an input to exposure (coordinator rulings 3.7-3.9).

items.item: KRX per-name cost buckets calibrated on quotes (P4 8/15/30/50 bp non-tax vs P6 tiers vs 35 bp flat)
items.settling_test: "Calibrate half-spread and impact on KIS quote snapshots (P4 D3 / DC-P6-05) by 20-day traded-value bucket; adopt only buckets >= 35 bp per side." (L489)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: No KIS quote history (L487, L1333). Corwin-Schultz convention-sensitive: 22-57 bp (cap buckets) or 99-117 bp (negatives zeroed), Jan-2024..Sep-2026 (L486; CA-11 L1254). Gate n/a (calibration).
items.passes_when: Binding floor: "a bucket may raise a name's cost, never lower it below 35 bp" (L484, L846, L818). Feeds GOV-7 cost header and INV-4 capacity (L804).

items.item: Daily-entry attention card (K-AF) and a 5-session no-new-long rule after locked limit-ups or volume spikes
items.settling_test: No §7 settling-test line (D-11). Register: "a daily-entry test passing at 35/70 bp adds a 5-session no-new-long rule to INV-2" (L847). OQ-12: "Add the executives' five-session no-new-long window after locked limit-ups or volume spikes once BL-TF-02 tests it?" (L1325).
items.data_prerequisite_gate: Event effects -93 to -579 bp over 5-20 sessions (L847; GV-197..200 L1079-1082). Needs daily limit-state flags (L802). Not run.
items.passes_when: Pass at 35/70 bp → INV-2 gains the 5-session window (owner, OQ-12). Never a monthly screen (DNB-TF-01).

items.item: US low-vol DC9: alpha net of beta with FF5+Mom; S_beta comparator at 50 bp
items.settling_test: "US: DC9 alpha net of beta with FF5+Mom and S_beta at 50 bp." (L497)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: No US stock panel (L848). US low-beta tercile Sharpe 0.65 vs 0.41 (1954-2017, gross); USMV -5.9 pp/yr vs IVV (L494). Not run.
items.passes_when: "a US stock panel and a pass against S_beta at 50 bp" (L848). US low-vol alpha 1, protective 1 (BACKLOG, vs S_beta) (L788). KR part is FS-3 (FORWARD-SIM descriptive), not backlog.

items.settling_test: "52wH-neutral and Samsung/SK hynix-capped momentum on KRX with the 2026 crash replay (P2 DC-J); D-M extension only after R-04 leaves INSUFFICIENT DATA." (L513)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: US 52wH-neutral WML* worst month -23.66% vs -74.06% (not a max drawdown; CA-08 L1251); untested on KRX (L510). Not run.
items.passes_when: "a KRX test with crash losses below the R-03-scaled book" (L849). D-M gate (R-04 / MOM-2) stays SPEC BOOK ONLY (G-13 L810; XS-15 L1303).

items.item: 52-week high: one Tier A test inside FS-2 (quarterly rebalance variant), feature weight 1
items.settling_test: "One pre-registered Tier A test inside the constrained-momentum card (start date fixed in the header), quarterly rebalance variant, 2x costs." (L521)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: +0.33%/month (t 2.14) from 2001-03 but +0.13%/month (t 0.81) from 1996-03; +0.07 at 70 bp; 52wH L/S lost 20.6% after the 2026 crash (L518; CA-13 L1256). Not run as a card.
items.passes_when: "a pass inside FS-2 from both the 1996 and 2001 starts" (L850). Weight stays 1 (feature), not the executives' 2 (L516, L522).

items.item: Crowding / comomentum sizing multiplier in [0.5, 1.0]
items.settling_test: "A comomentum multiplier must beat R-03 out of sample on a pre-registered KRX/US sleeve; until then display only." (L579)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: No Korean comomentum series computed (L576); VIX at 19 factor-crash onsets 12.9-25.8; GS record crowding Nov-2023 followed by further outperformance (L576).
items.passes_when: "beating R-03 out of sample" (L851). R-08 is not counted as factor-crash protection (XS-14 L1302; G-60 L872).

items.item: US stock-level 12-1 momentum as an R-03-scaled composite leg, weight 1
items.settling_test: "Run R-03-scaled US momentum as a composite leg at 50 bp per side on an FMP universe once a US stock panel exists." (L529)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: French WML Sharpe 0.36 (1990-2017/03), -0.16 (2008-2017/03); NMV 1.33%/month gross -> 0.68 net; MTUM +2.1 pp/yr vs IVV with -15.2 / -17.2 pp lags (L526). No US stock sleeve.
items.passes_when: "a US stock panel and a pass at 50 bp as an R-03-scaled composite leg" (L852). Final weight 1 (professors) vs macro R-15 "2 if vol-scaled + D-M" = Conflict, owner OQ-06 (XS-16 L1304; L1319).

items.item: US single-index trend / VT on a futures-cost instrument (5 bp)
items.settling_test: No §7 line. Register: "pooled markets for sufficiency" (L853); CR-02: "US single-index trend at 50 bp per side is REJECT, futures cost only, BACKLOG" (L30).
items.data_prerequisite_gate: At 5 bp: PC-1 +3.8 to +14.7 pp, INSUFFICIENT (53-56% of benefit from the GFC) (L397, L853). INSUFFICIENT DATA.
items.passes_when: Sufficiency via pooled markets (L853). Macro already carries this as R-29 MACRO-R06-US-FUT, a new card settled on 1926+ history (MS L6211, L6222; backlog ST-01). Weight: protective 1 at futures cost (L788; XS-09 L1297).

items.item: Diversified futures trend book: B3 re-registered with >= 25 markets, fixed multi-speed ensemble, diversifier claim
items.settling_test: "Continuous-futures panel for >= 25 markets, fixed multi-speed ensemble, diversifier claim vs cash plus portfolio uplift; gate-class approval." (L643)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: No local futures panel (L641, L1334). 67 markets 1880-2013 net Sharpe 0.77 after 2/20; trend excess 6.3%/yr (2000-09) vs 0.4%/yr over T-bills (2010-18; CA-19 L1262); B3 OOS Sharpe 0.08; AQMIX 10-year Sharpe ~0.30 (CA-36 L1279) (L640). Old B3 registration REJECT.
items.passes_when: "gate-class approval and a futures panel" (L854). Prior alpha ~0.0-0.3 after 2009, not "0.4-0.8 per asset, ~1.0 diversified" (L638). Yahoo continuous-futures returns across rolls are a macro data shortcut (MS item 19).

items.item: (a) KR-VQ composite (value + profitability + net issuance), OpenDART PIT, weight 2 BUILD-candidate; (b) Korean value and quality individual weights 1 each until a PIT test

(L651). (b) "OpenDART PIT test; value may rise to 2-3 only after a PIT pass that survives the 2024-02-26 split." (L545)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: No KR fundamentals locally (L649, L1332). Kang 2002-15 (gross, in sample): HML 1.05%/month (t 3.41), RMWq 0.65 (t 2.75), CMA 0.66 (t 3.57); 2000-19 replication: value 69.2%, profitability 5.0% (L648). OpenDART statements only from BY2015 (L806). Expected INSUFFICIENT DATA / REVISE.
items.passes_when: "OpenDART PIT store built and tested" (L842); "PIT pass surviving the 2024-02-26 split" (L844). On pass → SPEC §TF-6 FUND-1 (L652). Net issuance (KRX-only) already built as SCR-2 (L648).
items.cite: G-35 L842; G-37 L844; TF-36 (UNTESTED L646-652); TF-37 (CONTESTED L540-546)

items.item: Korean earnings-announcement drift, DART-timestamped, weight 1
items.settling_test: "DART-timestamped test: CAR[-1,+1] sign, entry at rcept_dt + 1 session, top two size terciles, must pass at 2x costs; then 2." (L553)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: Shin et al. 2002Q4-2017Q4: 60-day drift 4.80% (t 9.35), gross; ~2.9%/yr cost at 35 bp if fully turned over. Chair proxy 2006-2026 (gross): positive events -1.34% over 60 days (t -4.2), negative -2.68% (t -7.6) (L550). Not run.
items.passes_when: "pass at 2x costs in the top two size terciles -> 2" (L845). D-M gate never extends to earnings-momentum sleeves (L513; XS-15).

items.item: US-VQ composite (value + profitability + investment + issuance; value only inside it; combined with momentum at sleeve level), weight 2 BUILD-candidate
items.settling_test: "EDGAR acceptance + 1 session PIT store and FMP prices; sector-neutral, banded; 15+ years of XBRL; expect REVISE first." (L659)
items.data_prerequisite_gate: No US fundamentals locally (L657). NMV 1963-2012 gross -> net: value + profitability 0.82 -> 0.77%/month (t 4.82); investment 0.56 -> 0.46 (t 3.60); net issuance 0.57 -> 0.37 (t 2.43); expected net L/S Sharpe after decay at 50 bp 0.42 (0.37 at 2x; 0.17 after the 60% haircut); US HML -0.23 (2010-18) (L656). Expected REVISE.
items.passes_when: "FMP/EDGAR PIT store" (L843). On pass → SPEC §TF-6 FUND-2 (L660). Quality inside it is a composite leg at 2, never a hedge (DNB-TF-08).
